Friction Fixture Page

Pattern 1: Unlabeled Icon Button

The primary action uses an icon with no visible label or aria-label.

Pattern 2: Swapped Button Order

Continue and Cancel are in reversed positions (Cancel left, Continue right — opposite of convention).

Pattern 3: Placeholder / Validation Mismatch

Placeholder says "(555) 123-4567" but validation requires E.164 format (+15551234567).

Invalid format. Use +1XXXXXXXXXX.

Pattern 4: Disabled-Looking Active Button

This button is fully functional but styled to look disabled.

Pattern 5: Silent Success

Click Save to persist. No toast, no banner, no visible confirmation.

Data persisted.
